A ggplot of fixed width holding a legend block at its top left

Source: R/legends.R
legend_block_figure.Rd

Only the width is fixed: placed in a patchwork over several rows of fixed-size panels, the figure takes their height.

Usage

legend_block_figure(block, pad = 0.15)

Arguments

block

A legend block (legend_block_grob())

pad

Room left of the legends, in inches

Value

A ggplot object, with the block's measured height (inches, PDF metrics plus 5
